text:
**A** is the better summary.

Both responses fit under 120 words. A comes in at roughly 111 and B at roughly 95.

**A** is accurate and gives the manager more of what they'd need. It names who is responsible for each task: Laila coordinating the Clean Up Day and Peter booking the sound system. It also says the councillor will only *request* a speed counter and includes the Facebook action item. It stays tight and easy to scan.

**B** is shorter but has an accuracy problem. It says "Council will install a speed counter", when the councillor only said she would ask council traffic staff to put one on the road and report back. A busy manager who doesn't read the original would be misled. B also drops the owners of tasks and the Facebook item. It does add the school choir, which is a minor detail.

A is more accurate and more complete, and still within the limit.

**A**
